Coffee
summary: A full identity for a roastery on the quay, from the cart to the café.

body.p: The roaster started as a cart on the quay, selling coffee to the people waiting for the morning ferry.
We drew the letters from the old **ferry signs**, then set them on everything from cups to the van. See [the print work](/services/print) for the bags.
